strengths: Internally consistent non-human-subjects ethics posture: involves_human_subjects=false, de-identification rationale, regulatory status, cell-line sourcing with RRIDs and named ethics reviewers all agree
Deep, checksummed resource hierarchy across five Dataverse releases with valid DOIs, versions, dates and per-file formats, plus a clear account of how versions relate
End-to-end technical transparency: collection mechanisms per modality, raw-data repositories, the MuSIC pipeline and FAIRSCAPE packaging with named software, repositories, licences and a version
Complete motivation and funding block with valid NIH grant numbers and ORCID-identified creators
Source conflicts and ambiguities are surfaced in source_caveats with the reasoning used to resolve them rather than silently collapsed
weaknesses: No top-level doi or version for the record itself; the id is the project homepage
No variable-level metadata or tabular flag for any modality
No related_datasets or parent_datasets despite the U2OS reference map and the Bridge2AI programme being described in prose
No anomalies, sensitive_elements or content_warnings fields, and no explicit statement that the data carry no sensitive content
Software recorded under used_software rather than software_and_tools; machine annotation tool version given as 'GPT-4 unknown'
recommendations: Set top-level doi and version to the June 2026 release (10.18130/V3/HIGT4C, V2.0) and keep the per-release history in version_access
Add related_datasets entries for the U2OS multimodal map (same method, different cell line) and sibling Bridge2AI datasets with typed relationships
Add variables (image channels, interaction table columns, perturbation atlas fields) and is_tabular per collection
Add sensitive_elements stating that no personal or sensitive content is present, and an anomalies entry for any known QC issues
Move tool entries into software_and_tools with versions, and record the GPT-4 version as unstated rather than 'unknown' inside the tool name
